articles.title: Snap a Photo of Jupiter from Your Backyard!
articles.summary: You can take amazing pictures of planets with a regular telescope and camera. A trick called 'lucky imaging' stacks the sharpest video frames into one crisp photo. No fancy skills needed!

articles.title: James Webb Spots a Cosmic Lion in Space!
articles.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope took a new picture of the Lion Nebula, a giant cloud of gas and dust shaped like a lion's face. It was made by a dying star that's 'cooking' the nebula from inside!

articles.title: What Is ADHD? It's Not a Bad Thing—It's Just a Different Brain!
articles.summary: ADHD is a common way brains work differently, not a 'disorder.' It affects focus and energy, but also links to creativity. About 22 million Americans have it, including 6 million kids.
